proposal.what_would_change_it: Confirmation that NIR diffuse reflection adequately resolves the API without requiring surface ATR contact.
proposal.next_step: Conduct multi-method laboratory trials using representative polymer-API samples to evaluate MIR-ATR and NIR reflection.

brief_answer: To monitor composition changes in hot polymer extrusion, start with multi-method laboratory trials comparing MIR-ATR and NIR reflection probes. MIR-ATR provides high chemical specificity for fingerprinting, while NIR reflection suits robust barrel mounting. Clarify your polymer, API type, concentration range, and optical properties before selecting the final probe hardware.
